crossRefs.note: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
“Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth…
Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and…
who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still…
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my…
Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

translations.web: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
translations.bsb: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.
translations.kjv: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
translations.asv: For thou hast been a refuge for me, A strong tower from the enemy.
